## Execution prerequisites

- Use a freshly migrated database with the Sprint 12 seed data; never run this checklist against production.
- Prepare one active user for each role: `ADMINISTRATOR`, `GENERAL_MANAGER`, `MANAGER`, `MECHANIC`, `SUPERVISOR`.
- Prepare users with one-site access and with multi-site access to verify site scoping.
- Use a desktop browser for the web checks and a physical Android device for camera, offline, and WorkManager checks.
- Record the build SHA, database reset time, tester, date, and evidence links in the acceptance report.

## Cross-cutting checks

- [ ] `T35-GLOBAL-ROLE-MATRIX` **Role matrix** — Sign in as every role and confirm the visible web tabs and Android bottom tabs exactly match the role matrix. Direct navigation to an unauthorised screen or API must be denied.
  - State checks: `role-denied`: the control is absent for roles without permission and a forged request returns 403
- [ ] `T35-GLOBAL-SITE-SCOPE` **Site scope** — A one-site user never sees equipment, inspections, problems, maintenance, reports, imports, exports, or audit metadata from another site. A multi-site user sees only assigned sites.
  - State checks: `site-scope`: only sites assigned to the caller are visible and changing the filter never reveals another site
- [ ] `T35-GLOBAL-SESSION-EXPIRY` **Session expiry** — Expire the access token during a form, report action, and Android sync. The client refreshes or asks for sign-in without losing queued work or silently submitting twice.
  - State checks: `session-refresh`: an expired access token is refreshed once and the original request retries without losing user input; `api-error`: the server error is shown without discarding previously loaded data and retry remains available
- [ ] `T35-GLOBAL-EMPTY-ERROR-STATES` **Empty error states** — For every list and dashboard, verify loading, empty, and server-error states. A failed refresh keeps the previous usable view and offers retry.
  - State checks: `empty`: an explicit empty state is shown and the layout does not break; `api-error`: the server error is shown without discarding previously loaded data and retry remains available; `loading`: a busy indicator is shown and duplicate taps are ignored while the request is in flight
- [ ] `T35-GLOBAL-OFFLINE-WORK` **Offline work** — Put Android in airplane mode; open the app, start an inspection, record a status or breakdown, take a photo, and sign out only after the queue drains. No captured work may be lost.
  - State checks: `offline-cache`: cached data remains readable with no connection and the screen states when data was last synced; `offline-queue`: the action is stored encrypted on the device with a stable client reference and retried without data loss; `conflict`: a version conflict is surfaced with a review path and no data is silently overwritten
- [ ] `T35-GLOBAL-CONCURRENCY` **Concurrency** — Use two sessions to change the same maintenance, report, or breakdown record. The stale action must return 409 or 412 and offer a re-read path, never an overwrite.
  - State checks: `conflict`: a version conflict is surfaced with a review path and no data is silently overwritten
- [ ] `T35-GLOBAL-AUDIT-AND-SECURITY` **Audit and security** — Mutating actions appear in the audit trail, passwords never appear in logs or URLs, and unauthenticated requests to protected APIs return 401.
  - State checks: `audit`: the action is written to the immutable audit trail with actor, entity, and timestamp; `role-denied`: the control is absent for roles without permission and a forged request returns 403
- [ ] `T35-GLOBAL-ACCESSIBILITY-INPUT` **Accessibility input** — Complete the core workflows using keyboard only on web and TalkBack on Android. Focus order, error announcements, labels, and touch targets must remain usable.
  - State checks: `responsive`: the layout remains usable at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths without clipped primary actions; `validation`: missing or invalid input blocks submission and shows an inline explanation

## OpenAPI operation contract checklist

Every operation below must be exercised with an authorised user, an unauthorised role, and a site-scoped user where applicable.

### Authentication

- [ ] `T35-API-POST-API-V1-AUTH-CHANGE-PASSWORD` **POST /api/v1/auth/change-password** — Change the current user's password
  - Access: Authenticated: `bearerAuth`.
  - Inputs: body: application/json: `currentPassword` (required), `newPassword` (required).
  - Expected: success: `204` Password changed; errors: `400`; `401`.
  - UI mapping: `T35-WEB-CHANGE-PASSWORD-CURRENT-PASSWORD`, `T35-WEB-CHANGE-PASSWORD-NEW-PASSWORD`, `T35-WEB-CHANGE-PASSWORD-CHANGE-PASSWORD`, `T35-WEB-MORE-CHANGE-PASSWORD-DIALOG`
- [ ] `T35-API-POST-API-V1-AUTH-LOGIN` **POST /api/v1/auth/login** — Authenticate a user
  - Access: Public.
  - Inputs: body: application/json: `username` (required), `password` (required), `clientType`, `deviceLabel`.
  - Expected: success: `200` Session created; errors: `401`; `429`.
  - UI mapping: `T35-WEB-LOGIN-USERNAME`, `T35-WEB-LOGIN-PASSWORD`, `T35-WEB-LOGIN-SIGN-IN`, `T35-WEB-LOGIN-INVALID-CREDENTIALS`, `T35-ANDROID-LOGIN-USERNAME`, `T35-ANDROID-LOGIN-PASSWORD`, `T35-ANDROID-LOGIN-SIGN-IN`
- [ ] `T35-API-POST-API-V1-AUTH-LOGOUT` **POST /api/v1/auth/logout** — Revoke a refresh token and clear the refresh cookie
  - Access: Public.
  - Inputs: body: application/json: `refreshToken`.
  - Expected: success: `204` Session revoked; errors: documented error responses.
  - UI mapping: `T35-WEB-CHANGE-PASSWORD-SIGN-OUT`, `T35-WEB-SHELL-SIGN-OUT`, `T35-WEB-MORE-SIGN-OUT`
- [ ] `T35-API-POST-API-V1-AUTH-REFRESH` **POST /api/v1/auth/refresh** — Rotate an access token
  - Access: Public.
  - Inputs: body: application/json: `refreshToken`, `clientType`, `deviceLabel`.
  - Expected: success: `200` Session refreshed; errors: `401`.
  - UI mapping: `T35-WEB-SHELL-SESSION-REFRESH`
- [ ] `T35-API-GET-API-V1-ME` **GET /api/v1/me** — Return the authenticated user
  - Access: Authenticated: `bearerAuth`.
  - Inputs: None.
  - Expected: success: `200` Current user; errors: `401`.
  - UI mapping: `T35-WEB-LOGIN-SIGN-IN`, `T35-WEB-SHELL-CURRENT-USER`, `T35-WEB-MORE-REFRESH`, `T35-WEB-MORE-ACCOUNT-SUMMARY`, `T35-WEB-MORE-APPLICATION-INFO`, `T35-ANDROID-LOGIN-SIGN-IN`, `T35-ANDROID-MORE-ACCOUNT-SUMMARY`
